This is the default configuration for Tiny Tapeout projects. It should fit most designs.
If you change it, please make sure you understand what you are doing. We are not responsible
if your project fails because of a bad configuration.
!!! DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE unless you know what you are doing !!!
If you get stuck with this config, please open an issue or get in touch via the discord.
Here are some of the variables you may want to change:
PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - You can increase this if Global Placement fails with error GPL-0302.
Users have reported that values up to 80 worked well for them.
CLOCK_PERIOD - Increase this in case you are getting setup time violations.
The value is in nanoseconds, so 20ns == 50MHz.
Hold slack margin - Increase them in case you are getting hold violations.
Setup slack margin 0 after CTS: with 0.05 ns the 2,560 latch endpoints (borrow slack 0.000)
are setup 'violators' and the resizer loops for 4 h 19 min with no change (gds 40793488418);
margin 0 gives identical final metrics in 2 h 47 min (gds 40955756051). All runs, tape-out included.
OpenROAD threads: unset gives '-threads None' in LibreLane 3.1.0.dev3 (steps/openroad.py,
get_command), so detailed routing runs on one thread; 4 = CPUs of the ubuntu-24.04 runner.
No Magic DRC: with the SRAM macros it reports about 173,000 rule-exception shapes inside the macro
layout; the DRC signoff is the precheck's SG13CMOS5L KLayout deck on every push (docs/decisions.md 20).
Reserve of docs/decisions.md entry 5 (d): timing-driven placement, 1.2 ns max transition in PnR.
Signoff STA only: path groups so the flip-flop setup slack is reported (layout unchanged).
Clock tree: at most 8 sinks per leaf buffer (cell library default_max_fanout 8) and buffers every
200 um on the trunk; max fanout pins 84 -> 8 (antenna diodes only), fast hold +0.010 -> +0.099 ns
(gds 43672052931 vs 43693862885). docs/signoff.md, max fanout.
IHP SRAM macros (pe_sram) at the bottom edge (the tile pins are at the top left). FS puts the
signal pins on top, facing the logic, and keeps the Metal4 supply columns vertical; x = 11.04 + 67.44 k
keeps the columns under the stripes (src/pdn_cfg.tcl). Instance keys are the flattened paths.
Both macro supplies go to VPWR, the only supply a tile has.
Full-height stripes through the macro supply columns, checked in the PDN step (src/pdn_cfg.tcl);
the power-grid checker stays a fatal check. FP_PDN_VPITCH below is 67.44 (docs/decisions.md).
Magic reads the macro LEF, where the POWER stripes cross a Metal4 OBS at the VDD!/VDDARRAY! break.
LVS treats the macros as black boxes (abstract cells).
Max slew and max capacitance violations at any corner stop the run, as setup and hold do.
SRAM pins: input max_transition 0.595 ns and A_DOUT max_capacitance 0.064 pF (macro liberty, slow).
The repair margins alone left 29 slew pins and 1 cap pin at the macros (SRAM smoke run 43925649736);
a 150 um wire-length cap in both design repairs removed them at all corners (run 43941919810).
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - Disabling the linter is not recommended!
If you need a custom clock configuration, read the following documentation first:
https://tinytapeout.com/faq/#how-can-i-map-an-additional-external-clock-to-one-of-the-gpios
Configuration docs: https://librelane.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/configuration.html
